correctness.rationale: Every idempotent is uniquely a clamp. The commuting condition is reconstructed at each interior/exterior point, giving independent left/right binary-step choices and a binomial interior count. The weighted sum proves C exactly, including n=1, k=0 and all endpoints. The equivalence of the two closed forms and strict placement extremizers follow by algebra and convexity. Uniform logarithmic bound plus an exact stars-and-bars minimum-gap survival law gives the CDF and bounded mean convergence. Exhaustive independent direct-composition verification passed for n=1..10; finite checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: Centralizers are canonical semigroup invariants, and the paper-specific gap is not just another idempotent count. The formula classifies all idempotent centralizer-size strata for every n; it quantifies geometric placement extremizers. The associated nondegenerate quadratic logarithmic limit identifies a new macroscopic probabilistic law for centralizer growth and a sharp mean exponent 8/9. These natural complete profiles are motivated independently of checker construction, not arbitrary fixed parameters or routine normalization.
